sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Lesson 11.6: Generative Label Modeling and Matrix Completion. Having formulated programmatic Labeling Functions in Lesson 11.5, we now dissect the mathematical engine that recovers latent rule accuracies purely from unlabeled votes.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Today, we derive log-linear Ising factor graphs, prove how conditional independence yields a Rank-1 plus diagonal covariance decomposition, construct the closed-form FlyingSquid Triplet Estimator, and prove how deep end-model distillation surpasses heuristic ceilings.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us trace the four mathematical stages of generative label modeling. Stage 1 computes the empirical covariance matrix Sigma of the sparse votes Lambda. Stage 2 treats off-diagonal entries as a Rank-1 matrix completion problem.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Stage 3 applies the algebraic Triplet Estimator to extract each rule's latent accuracy without gold supervision. Finally, Stage 4 multiplies log-odds weights to generate calibrated soft targets y tilde in zero to one, distilling them into deep neural classifiers that expand coverage to one hundred percent.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Definition 11.6.1 formalizes the joint probability of observed votes Lambda and latent class Y as a log-linear Markov Random Field, or Ising energy model. Three potentials parameterize accuracy theta acc, propensity theta prop, and edge correlation theta corr.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Normalized by partition function Z of theta across all two times three to the m states, Maximum Marginal Likelihood Estimation maximizes the log sum over latent Y in plus or minus one purely from unlabeled observed matrices.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Definition 11.6.2 reveals the central linear algebraic breakthrough of Snorkel and FlyingSquid. When labeling functions are conditionally independent given latent Y, cross-moments factorize into conditional expectations.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: For distinct rules j and k under balanced priors, pairwise covariance equals z j times z k, where z j is the latent covariance between rule j and truth Y. Thus the empirical covariance matrix Sigma decomposes exactly into a rank-1 outer product z z transpose plus a diagonal residual Omega!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Definition 11.6.3 derives the closed-form Triplet Estimator. For any triad of rules j, k, and l, multiplying Sigma j k by Sigma j l and dividing by Sigma k l isolates z j squared cleanly.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Sign symmetry between plus z and minus z is resolved assuming average domain heuristics align positively with truth. Taking the robust median across all auxiliary pairs yields z j star, which converts directly to conditional rule precision a j via rule coverage.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Interactive Lab 1 below: the Empirical Covariance Matrix and Triplet Inversion Studio! On Canvas 1, inspect the 5-by-5 empirical covariance matrix Sigma across five labeling functions from RegexOracle to DistantKB.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: On Canvas 2, compare closed-form FlyingSquid Triplet Inversion accuracies in green against true oracle precision in amber. Vary sample size N and noise eta to see mean absolute accuracy error shrink toward zero!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Time for Active Checkpoint 1 from Self-Assessment 1! Given three conditionally independent LFs with off-diagonal covariances Sigma 12 equals zero point two four, Sigma 13 equals zero point one eight, and Sigma 23 equals zero point one two, plus empirical coverage zero point seven five for LF 1.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Solve for latent covariance z1 and convert it into the exact conditional accuracy a1 without using any gold labels.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Definition 11.6.4 completes the mathematical bridge from inferred accuracies to deep neural networks. Each LF receives log-odds weight w j equals natural log of a j over 1 minus a j, emitting calibrated sigmoid targets y tilde i.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Training a continuous deep model f w via noise-aware soft cross-entropy risk produces the Coverage Expansion Theorem: excess risk on previously abstained instances shrinks as square root of d log n over n, allowing transformers to interpolate seamlessly across uncovered regions.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: One of the costliest anti-patterns in weak supervision pipelines is rounding probabilistic soft targets y tilde greater or equal to zero point five into binary zeros and ones before training the neural classifier.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Hard thresholding treats an ambiguous instance at y tilde zero point five one identically to a unanimous rule consensus at zero point nine nine, destroying epistemic confidence calibration and biasing network weights toward noisy conflict samples.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Now inspect Interactive Lab 2 below: Calibrated Soft Posteriors versus End-Model Distillation Gain! On Canvas 3, contrast FlyingSquid's smooth continuous sigmoid against Majority Vote's jagged staircase artifacts.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Switch between FlyingSquid Rank-1 and Uniform Majority Vote, adjust noise and correlation stress sliders, and watch the green distilled deep model curve on Canvas 4 soar above the dashed cyan rule ceiling toward ninety-five percent Gold Bayes parity.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Time for Active Checkpoint 2 from Self-Assessment 2! In a legal contract review pipeline, regex labeling functions cover sixty-two percent of clauses at F1 zero point eight one, yet a distilled RoBERTa classifier rises to zero point eight eight across one hundred percent of clauses.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Identify the mathematical and geometric reasons why continuous neural distillation out-generalizes the very heuristic rules that generated its targets.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us examine two extraordinary matrix completion deployments. At Stanford Medicine, SwellShark combined forty-five clinical rules across UMLS ontologies and ICD-10 codes to label two hundred thousand discharge summaries in under twenty-four hours—training a BioBERT extractor that matched twelve months of manual physician effort at F1 zero point eight seven two.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: At Intel Semiconductor Labs, engineers applied thirty-two optical and geometric inspection LFs across two million scanning electron micrographs. FlyingSquid solved rank-1 covariance completion in three point eight seconds on CPU, distilling a ResNet-50 defect classifier achieving ninety-six point four percent precision!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Time for Active Checkpoint 3! When deploying closed-form triplet estimators in production, two numerical edge cases arise: near-zero overlap pairs causing Sigma k l near zero, and the global sign ambiguity between plus z and minus z.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Identify the numerical safeguards that prevent triplet division blowups and ensure estimated accuracies point in the true class orientation.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us review production engineering discipline for matrix completion label models. Always distill continuous soft targets into deep classifiers rather than deploying rule aggregators directly, aggregate triplets with robust medians, and gate small off-diagonal covariances.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Avoid hard-rounding soft posteriors, avoid fitting triplet estimators on fewer than three overlapping LFs, and never confuse raw covariance z j with unscaled conditional precision a j.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Slide 15 displays the complete Pydantic V2 CovarianceLabelModel from your chapter. Notice how fit computes the empirical covariance matrix in one vectorized pass, sweeps valid auxiliary pairs k l gated by min triplet cov, and aggregates with np median.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: It then unscales z vector by per-LF coverage to recover true conditional accuracies, converts them into log-odds weights, and evaluates calibrated soft posteriors via predict proba.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: To conclude Lesson 11.6, master these four mathematical takeaways: conditional independence reduces generative factor graphs to Rank-1 matrix completion; off-diagonal triplet inversion recovers latent accuracies without gold labels; median aggregation prevents denominator blowups; and distilling continuous soft targets into deep backbones expands coverage to one hundred percent.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Explore the papers from Ratner, Bach, Fu, Chen, Varma, Fries, and Zhang. In Lesson 11.7, we explore Self-Supervised Representation Pretraining—learning powerful feature manifolds from zero labels!
